about.affine-proof: proofs about functions linear over GF(2): CRC (bit-serial and table), LFSR, xorshift, Gray code, parity
about.captured: fw-hdl's own output (examples/xls/crc32), as its printer wrote it
about.codegen-equiv: pipelined Verilog (yosys write_smt2 -stbv) against its combinational specification, at the right latency and one cycle off
about.inverse: inverse queries: CRC, hash and LFSR preimages, checksum collisions
about.mixed-proof: proofs mixing arithmetic with bit operations: checksums, FNV-1a, murmur fmix, SECDED, popcount, clz, saturating add
about.quickcheck-trivial: tiny proofs and refutations (16 input bits or fewer): start-up and per-query cost
about.refute: the same families with a bug: find the counterexample
